published_implementation.historical_relation: The pinned first-party STALE-bench repository contains validated benchmark instances, the benchmark implementation, corrected grading logic, committed stochastic agent-study outputs, and the raw result surfaces used by the publication. The evaluated parallel-work and communication conditions are benchmark-defined rather than a native canonical harness boundary.

observations.evidence_surface: STALE synthetic, corrected mined-real, and real-derived semantic-interference study

evidence_tiers.reported_finding: The first-party README reports interference approximately tracking planted staleness and one precise message recovering 98% of the synthetic interference cases.
evidence_tiers.cross_model_control_summary: The stronger gpt-5.5 reproduction uses planted symbols and is reported to reproduce the planted interference relation, reducing a memorization-based explanation for the synthetic result.

evidence_tiers.interpretation: Under the corrected grading protocol, the mined-real 417-pair corpus is a negative control: the first-party report finds essentially no observable semantic interference rather than the high rate suggested by the earlier naive metric.

evidence_tiers.construction: 12 helpers anchored to real validated Django pull-request pairs, each instantiated with three semantic-interference mechanisms

methodological_correction.problem_1: Agent test edits combined with permissive three-way application of gold test patches could create vacuous solo passes while the same tests applied in the clean merged condition.
methodological_correction.problem_2: Solo conditions were previously graded only on their own task labels while the merged condition used the union, so cross-task breakage could be invisible in solo runs and appear only after composition.
methodological_correction.corrected_protocol: Discard agent test edits, grade every condition on the union test set, and count a pair as observable only when both agents solve their own task.
methodological_correction.exclusion_reason: The repository marks these surfaces as using the naive or otherwise uncorrected metric. They are retained for measurement-history/context and are not used for capability claims in this observation.

observations.result_summary: STALE reports strong semantic-interference attenuation from precise communication in controlled synthetic and real-derived parallel-coding conditions, while the corrected mined-real Django corpus shows essentially no observable interference. These materially different tiers are preserved separately rather than collapsed into one headline rate.
observations.provenance_limitation: The repository publishes the deterministic benchmark core and committed raw stochastic agent outputs, but OpenSiro has not independently rerun the model-backed experiments. The strong communication-recovery findings belong to benchmark-defined synthetic and real-derived conditions; the corrected mined-real corpus is a negative control and must not be represented as supporting the same high interference rate.
